The '''Commenor Diamonds''' was a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] team that was active during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], the Commenor Diamonds won the [[Galactic League/Legends|Galactic League]] shcckball competition after defeating the [[Kuat Artisans]] in the final.
